proposed_widenings.name: passive_upgrade family for ClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Improved Brutal Strike (L17) is a passive, always-on enhancement of an existing feature. It has no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The only current ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three. A 'passive_upgrade' (or 'passive_modifier') family is needed to represent features that unconditionally improve parameters of another named feature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10. In addition, you can use two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use your Brutal Strike feature.

proposed_widenings.name: cross_feature_reference attachment or effect target
proposed_widenings.justification: Both sub-effects of this feature operate on parameters of barbarian_brutal_strike_l9, not on a creature or area. The surface has no mechanism to point an effect at another named feature record as its scope. A cross-feature reference (targeting a sibling feature by id) is needed to express 'this upgrades feature X'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10.

proposed_widenings.name: multi_effect_selection — select N from a named effect list
proposed_widenings.justification: The second component grants the ability to select *two* Brutal Strike effects simultaneously instead of one. The existing surface has no concept of 'effect multiplicity count' or 'choose N from a feature's effect menu'. This is distinct from all current effect atoms and usage-limit patterns.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can use two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use your Brutal Strike feature.

proposed_widenings.name: scale_feature_parameter — upgrade a named damage expression on a sibling feature
proposed_widenings.justification: The damage increase ('increases to 2d10') does not describe a self-contained DiceAmount; it is a write to a specific parameter slot of an already-authored feature. The existing scale_* atoms (scale_die_count, scale_numeric_bonus, etc.) all operate on a DiceAmount within the same unit. A mechanism to rewrite a named parameter on a referenced feature is missing.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10.

notes: This unit is the L17 upgrade of the Brutal Strike chain (L9 base, L13 first improvement, L17 second improvement). All three are passive-enhancement entries that modify earlier-defined behavior rather than introduce self-contained mechanics. None of them fit the activation family. The structural gap is the absence of a 'passive_upgrade' family and a cross-feature-reference target mechanism. The 'two effects' component compounds the gap by requiring a new multi-select-from-named-list concept. No partial encoding is attempted because even the simpler sub-effect (damage scaling) has no honest surface representation without lying about the target.
